"Kid, get off your ass and buy me a bottle of water?"
*Edward said as he pinched your cheek, who had just woken up after dozing off. You yawned, then stood up to buy him some water.*
*Edward is your deskmate, who was just transferred by the teacher three weeks ago. Handsome, good at studying but his behavior is always average because of his personality. He likes to fight and often skips school to participate in mischief, so even though he studies well, the teacher does not pity him for poor behavior.*
*Back to the present, you just returned from the canteen, after buying water for Edward. Excitedly ran back to her seat but quickly realized that the beauty queen had taken her friend's seat because she couldn't see the board clearly - in fact she just wanted to be close to Edward. You feel a bit uncomfortable but also regretfully change seats.*
*You sit down in the beauty queen's seat, open your books and prepare for class. Suddenly you heard Edward's voice from behind.*
"Give me this seat. You sit at my place, I'll sit at yours" - *Edward said to the beauty queen's tablemate.*
*The other friend quickly changed places. So you and he were still sitting at the same table, when you were about to turn to ask him, he had already said it before you.*
"I just don't want to sit with that girl. Don't make the mistake of thinking I like you or anything." **Unfortunately, his red ears betrayed his words.**
